destination.description: Destination page type to filter by. `APP` applies when the ad group's `promotion_type` is `APP_ANDROID` or `APP_IOS`. `TIKTOK_INSTANT_PAGE` applies when the ad specifies a TikTok Instant Page `page_id`. `WEBSITE` applies when the ad specifies `landing_page_url`. dimensions.description: Hierarchy — lower levels need anchoring filters, else 40002: - advertiser_id, campaign_id — usable alone - item_group_id, room_id — need filtering.campaign_ids - item_id — needs filtering.campaign_ids AND filtering.item_group_ids - duration — needs filtering.room_ids (LIVE) or filtering.item_group_ids (Product) - stat_time_day, stat_time_hour — time splits, never alone Dimension groupings for the report. Supported values: `advertiser_id` (group by advertiser ID), `campaign_id` (group by campaign ID), `stat_time_day` (group by day; time-split dimension, cannot be used alone), `stat_time_hour` (group by hour; time-split dimension, cannot be used alone), `item_group_id` (group by SPU ID), `item_id` (group by post ID), `room_id` (group by room ID), and `duration` (group by duration). Example: `["campaign_id", "stat_time_day"]` groups by campaign and day. Available dimensions vary by the metric type you query.

The allowed date range depends on `dimensions`: if `dimensions` does not include `stat_time_day` or `stat_time_hour`, the range can be up to 365 days; if `dimensions` includes `stat_time_day`, the range can be up to 30 days; if `dimensions` includes `stat_time_hour`, the range can be up to one day.

advertiser_id.description: Pass either `advertiser_id`/`advertiser_ids` or `bc_id`. When `report_type` is `BASIC` or `AUDIENCE`, pass `advertiser_id` or `advertiser_ids`; if both are provided, `advertiser_id` is ignored. When `report_type` is `PLAYABLE_MATERIAL`, `CATALOG`, or `TT_SHOP`, pass `advertiser_id`. When `report_type` is `BC`, pass `bc_id` instead. Advertiser ID.

advertiser_ids.description: Valid only when `report_type` is `BASIC` or `AUDIENCE`. You must pass either `advertiser_id` or `advertiser_ids`; if both are provided, `advertiser_id` is ignored. List of advertiser IDs, maximum size 5. When `advertiser_ids` is used, the response can include up to 20,000 IDs; cutoff is based on campaign, ad group, or ad creation time in descending order, and IDs may not be evenly distributed across advertisers. Returned `metrics` will include `currency`, `timezone`, and `advertiser_id`. Because advertisers can use different time zones, use `multi_adv_report_in_utc_time=true` to return all advertisers in UTC+0; otherwise data is returned in each advertiser's local time zone. Because advertisers can use different currencies, returned metric values use each advertiser's currency and are presented without a decimal point. To get total aggregated metrics across all advertiser IDs, enable `enable_total_metrics`; returned `total_metrics` will include `currency`, `timezone`, and `advertiser_id`, all set to `-`. If you use `advertiser_ids` but do not include any ID dimensions in `dimensions`, the response returns `0` for `currency`, `timezone`, and `advertiser_id`, and `-` for cost-related metrics such as `spend`. All advertisers in `advertiser_ids` must belong to the same TikTok for Business user or the request fails.

bc_id.description: Pass either `advertiser_id`/`advertiser_ids` or `bc_id`. When `report_type` is `BC`, pass `bc_id`. When `report_type` is `BASIC` or `AUDIENCE`, use `advertiser_id` or `advertiser_ids` instead. When `report_type` is `PLAYABLE_MATERIAL`, `CATALOG`, or `TT_SHOP`, use `advertiser_id`. ID of a Business Center you have access to.

data_level.description: Data level to query. Not supported when `report_type` is `BC`. Required when `report_type` is `BASIC`, `AUDIENCE`, or `CATALOG`. If set to `AUCTION_ADVERTISER`, data for all Auction Ads and Reservation Ads under the advertiser is returned. When `report_type` is `BASIC`, `AUDIENCE`, or `CATALOG`: `AUCTION_CAMPAIGN` returns data for all ads under undeleted auction campaigns because the default `campaign_status` filter is `STATUS_NOT_DELETE`; `AUCTION_ADGROUP` returns data for all ads under undeleted auction ad groups because the default `adgroup_status` filter is `STATUS_NOT_DELETE`; `AUCTION_AD` returns only undeleted ads under all auction campaigns because the default `ad_status` filter is `STATUS_NOT_DELETE`. To get data for all ads under all auction campaigns, set the `ad_status` filter to `STATUS_ALL` in `filtering`. When `report_type` is `TT_SHOP`, only `AUCTION_ADVERTISER` and `AUCTION_CAMPAIGN` are allowed.

dimensions.description: Grouping dimensions, for example `["campaign_id", "stat_time_day"]`. Supported dimensions vary by `report_type`. If `report_type` is not `BC` and `dimensions` contains `stat_time_day`, the query time range cannot exceed 30 days. If `dimensions` contains `stat_time_hour`, the query time range cannot exceed 1 day. If `dimensions` contains more than `xx_id` and there is no ads reporting within the time range, an empty list is returned.

enable_total_metrics.description: Whether to return total aggregated values for the requested metrics. When enabled, aggregate data across all pages is returned, so you only need to specify this field on the first page request. Because of the 20,000 truncation limit, totals are provided for up to 20,000 IDs. Supported only for auction basic reports and GMV max ads reports. Valid only when `dimensions` contains one ID dimension and optionally `stat_time_day`, for example `["campaign_id"]` or `["campaign_id", "stat_time_day"]`. Not supported in the sandbox environment.

end_date.description: Required when `query_lifetime` is `false` or omitted. Query end date in `YYYY-MM-DD`, using the ad account time zone. When `query_lifetime=true`, this field is ignored. If `report_type` is not `BC` and `dimensions` does not include `stat_time_day`, the maximum range between `start_date` and `end_date` is 365 days. If `report_type` is not `BC` and `dimensions` includes `stat_time_day`, the maximum range is 30 days. If `report_type` is `BC`, the maximum range is 365 days.

filtering.description: Filtering conditions. Supported when `report_type` is `BASIC`, `AUDIENCE`, `PLAYABLE_MATERIAL`, `CATALOG`, or `BC`; not supported when `report_type` is `TT_SHOP`. Supported filters vary by `service_type` and `data_level`. When you provide `filtering`, each object in the list must include `field_name`, `filter_type`, and `filter_value` together. If you want to use `country_code` as a grouping filter, you must also include `country_code` in `dimensions`. `country_code` works with basic report (sync and async), audience report (sync and async), playable ad report (sync only), and Business Center report (sync only).

filter_type.description: Filter operator. When `filter_type` is `IN`, `CONTAIN_ANY_OF`, or `NOT_IN`, `filter_value` must be a valid JSON array string. When `filter_type` is `BETWEEN`, `filter_value` must be a valid JSON array string containing exactly two string values.

filter_value.description: Value to filter by. When `filter_type` is `IN`, `CONTAIN_ANY_OF`, or `NOT_IN`, this must be a valid JSON array string.

metrics.description: Metrics to query. Supported metrics vary by `report_type`. Default is `["spend", "impressions"]` when `report_type` is `BASIC`, `AUDIENCE`, `PLAYABLE_MATERIAL`, or `CATALOG`; all metrics supported by the selected `dimensions` when `report_type` is `BC`; and `["spend", "billed_cost"]` when `report_type` is `TT_SHOP`. Currency metrics are based on the advertiser account currency.

multi_adv_report_in_utc_time.description: Supported only when `advertiser_ids` is used. Default is `false`. If `true`, returned metrics for all advertisers use UTC+0. If `false`, returned metrics use each advertiser's local time zone.

order_field.description: Sorting field. All supported metrics except attribute metrics can be used for sorting. By default, results are not sorted.

page.description: Current page number. Default is `1`.

page_size.description: Pagination size. Range: 1-1000. Default is `10`.

query_lifetime.description: Whether to request lifetime metrics. Supported only when `report_type` is `BASIC` or `PLAYABLE_MATERIAL`. Default is `false`. If `true`, `start_date` and `end_date` are ignored, and lifetime metrics use the same metric names as normal metrics. Breakdown by time, audience, or location code `country_code` is not supported for lifetime queries. Audience reports, DSA reports, Business Center reports, and GMV max ads reports do not support lifetime metrics.

report_type.description: Report type. When `service_type` is `AUCTION`, `BASIC`, `AUDIENCE`, `PLAYABLE_MATERIAL`, `CATALOG`, and `TT_SHOP` are supported. When `report_type` is `BC`, do not pass `service_type`. `BASIC` and `AUDIENCE` require `advertiser_id` or `advertiser_ids`; `PLAYABLE_MATERIAL`, `CATALOG`, and `TT_SHOP` use `advertiser_id`; `BC` uses `bc_id`.

service_type.description: Ad service type. Not supported when `report_type` is `BC`. Default is `AUCTION` when `report_type` is not `BC`. To retrieve TopView reporting data, use basic or audience reports and set the `buying_type` filter to `RESERVATION_TOP_VIEW`.

start_date.description: Required when `query_lifetime` is `false` or omitted. Query start date in `YYYY-MM-DD`, using the ad account time zone. When `query_lifetime=true`, this field is ignored. If `report_type` is not `BC` and `dimensions` does not include `stat_time_day`, the maximum range between `start_date` and `end_date` is 365 days. If `report_type` is not `BC` and `dimensions` includes `stat_time_day`, the maximum range is 30 days. If `report_type` is `BC`, the maximum range is 365 days.

advertiser_id.description: Advertiser ID. If you used `advertiser_ids` when calling /report/task/create/ (POST), this field must be set to one of the advertiser IDs included in that `advertiser_ids` list.

task_id.description: ID of the asynchronous report task. Obtain this value from the response of /report/task/create/.

language.description: Language for translating returned region names. Defaults to `en`. Supported values: `zh`, `fr`, `es`, `ko`, `vi`, `en`, `hi`, `it`, `tr`, `ru`, `ja`, `id`, `de`, `ms`, `ar`, and `th`. If you pass an unsupported value, the API returns results in the default `en`.

fields.description: Fields to return. If omitted, all fields are returned by default. Allowed values are the response fields under `list` and under `ad_configuration`, except `advertiser_id` and `smart_plus_ad_id`, which are returned by default.

filtering.description: Filtering conditions. Example: `filtering={"objective_type":"APP_PROMOTION"}`.

adgroup_ids.description: Filter by ad group IDs. Max size: 100.

campaign_ids.description: Filter by campaign IDs. Max size: 100.

creation_filter_end_time.description: Latest ad creation time to include, in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` (UTC). Returns ads created before this time. Example: `2025-02-01 00:00:01`. If both `creation_filter_start_time` and `creation_filter_end_time` are omitted, ads created at any time are included. For task efficiency and speed, consider setting a creation-time range within six months.

creation_filter_start_time.description: Earliest ad creation time to include, in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` (UTC). Returns ads created after this time. Example: `2025-01-01 00:00:01`. If both `creation_filter_start_time` and `creation_filter_end_time` are omitted, ads created at any time are included. For task efficiency and speed, consider setting a creation-time range within six months.

modified_after.description: Latest ad modification time lower bound, in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` (UTC). Returns ads last modified after this time. For task efficiency and speed, consider setting a time range within six months for the creation time filters.

objective_type.description: Filter by advertising objective. Supported values for this endpoint are `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, and `LEAD_GENERATION`.

sales_destination.description: Sales destination to drive toward. `WEBSITE` drives sales on your website. `APP` drives sales in your app and requires a product catalog. `WEB_AND_APP` drives sales on both your website and app.

secondary_status.description: Filter by ad secondary status. Includes the following Upgraded Smart+ statuses: `AD_STATUS_DELIVERY_AND_REAUDIT` (review of modifications in progress), `AD_STATUS_DELIVERY_AND_TRANSCODING_FAIL` (video transcoding failed), `AD_STATUS_REVIEW_PARTIALLY_APPROVED` (ad is partially reviewed and delivering), `AD_STATUS_COLLECTION_TOGGLED_OFF` (lead collection has ended), `AD_STATUS_PRIVACY_POLICY_REJECTED` (rejected due to privacy policy violations), and `AD_STATUS_PRIVACY_POLICY_AUDIT` (in privacy policy review).

smart_plus_ad_ids.description: Filter by ad IDs. Max size: 100.

page.description: Current page number. Value range: greater than or equal to 1. Default: 1.

page_size.description: Page size. Value range: 1 to 100. Default: 10.

include_reject_info.description: Whether to include rejection reasons in the response. Supported values: `true`, `false`. Default value: `false`.

include_violation_frame.description: Whether to include video frames flagged for violations. Supported values: `true`, `false`. Default value: `false`. You can set this field to `true` only when `include_reject_info` is `true`.

lang.description: Language code used for the returned `reasons`, `suggestion`, and `specification` fields inside each `reject_info` object. Default value: `en`.

smart_plus_ad_ids.description: List of Smart+ Ad IDs to query. Maximum 100 IDs per request.

fields.description: Fields to return. If omitted, all fields are returned by default.

filtering.description: Filtering conditions. Example: `filtering={"objective_type":"APP_PROMOTION"}`.

adgroup_ids.description: Filter by ad group IDs. Max size: 100.

campaign_ids.description: Filter by campaign IDs. Max size: 100.

objective_type.description: Advertising objective. Supported values are `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, and `LEAD_GENERATION`.

optimization_goal.description: The measurable result to drive. Supported values are `CLICK`, `INSTALL`, `IN_APP_EVENT`, `VALUE`, `CONVERT`, `TRAFFIC_LANDING_PAGE_VIEW`, and `LEAD_GENERATION`.

primary_status.description: Primary status. Default is `STATUS_NOT_DELETE`, which returns ad groups in all statuses except `STATUS_DELETE`. To include deleted ad groups, use `STATUS_ALL`.

promotion_type.description: Promotion type (optimization location). Valid values depend on other fields: when `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION` and `app_promotion_type` is `APP_INSTAL`, this is `APP_ANDROID` or `APP_IOS`; when `objective_type` is `APP_PROMOTION` and `app_promotion_type` is `MINIS`, this is `MINI_APP`, `MINI_GAME`, or `NATIVE_SERIES`; when `objective_type` is `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, this is `WEBSITE` if `sales_destination` is `WEBSITE`, or `APP_ANDROID`/`APP_IOS` if `sales_destination` is `APP`; when `objective_type` is `LEAD_GENERATION`, this is `LEAD_GENERATION`, `LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_TT_DIRECT_MESSAGE`, `LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_SOCIAL_MEDIA_APP_MESSAGE`, or `LEAD_GEN_CLICK_TO_CALL`.

sales_destination.description: Sales destination. `WEBSITE` drives sales on your website. `APP` drives sales on your app and requires a product catalog. `WEB_AND_APP` drives sales on both your website and your app.

page.description: Current page number. Default value: 1. Value range: greater than or equal to 1.

page_size.description: Page size. Default value: 10. Value range: 1-1000.

fields.description: List of campaign fields to return. If omitted, all fields are returned by default. Allowed values are the field names under the response `list` object.

filtering.description: Filtering conditions for the campaign query. Example: `filtering={"objective_type":"APP_PROMOTION"}`.

campaign_ids.description: Filter by campaign IDs. Maximum 100 IDs.

campaign_name.description: Filter by campaign name. Fuzzy match is supported.

creation_filter_end_time.description: Latest campaign creation time, in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` UTC format. Returns campaigns created before this time. Example: `2025-02-01 00:00:01`. If both `creation_filter_start_time` and `creation_filter_end_time` are omitted, campaigns from any creation time are included. For efficiency and speed, TikTok recommends using a creation-time range within 6 months.

creation_filter_start_time.description: Earliest campaign creation time, in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` UTC format. Returns campaigns created after this time. Example: `2025-01-01 00:00:01`. If both `creation_filter_start_time` and `creation_filter_end_time` are omitted, campaigns from any creation time are included. For efficiency and speed, TikTok recommends using a creation-time range within 6 months.

sales_destination.description: Sales destination to filter by. `WEBSITE`: drive sales on your website. `APP`: drive sales on your app; product catalog required. `WEB_AND_APP`: drive sales on both your website and your app.

page.description: Current page number. Default value: 1. Value range: greater than or equal to 1.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Default value: 10. Value range: 1-1,000.

ad_material_ids.description: List of ad material IDs for the creatives to query. An ad material ID is an ad-specific material ID generated when a particular creative is used in an ad, and it differs from the creative ID from the account Creative Library. Maximum 100 IDs. To obtain ad material IDs associated with an ad, use /smart_plus/ad/get/. For images within a carousel, provide the `ad_material_id` from /smart_plus/ad/review_info/, not the one from /smart_plus/ad/get/ that identifies the entire carousel.

extra_info_setting.description: Additional settings for whether rejection details and flagged violation frames are returned.

include_reject_info.description: Whether to include rejection reasons. Supported values: `true`, `false`. Default value: `false`.

include_violation_frame.description: Whether to include video frames flagged for violations. Supported values: `true`, `false`. Default value: `false`. You can set this field to `true` only when `include_reject_info` is `true`.

lang.description: Language code for the returned `reasons`, `suggestion`, and `specification` fields within the `reject_info` object array. Default value: `en`.
Language of the agreement. Accepted values are `EN`, `JA`, and `ZH`. Defaults to `EN` if omitted.

term_type.description: Type of agreement to retrieve. Currently only `LeadAds` is supported.

url.description: Open TikTok URL to convert into a TikTok internal link.

url_type.description: Type of the open TikTok URL. Supported values: `USER_PROFILE`; `VIDEO` for a video detail page; `HASHTAG_CHALLENGE` for a hashtag challenge page; `MUSIC` for a music page; `STICKER` for a sticker (special effect) page; `STICKER_SHOOTER` to shoot a video with a sticker (special effect).

url.description: URL to validate. The endpoint checks whether it is a custom URL scheme, an Apple universal link, or an Android App Link, and whether it is valid.

brand_safety_partner.description: Brand safety partner. Required when `brand_safety_type` is `THIRD_PARTY`, and `placements` must be `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`. Pre-bid third-party brand safety is allowlist-only.

brand_safety_type.description: Brand safety setting. Valid only when `placements` is `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`. Default is `NO_BRAND_SAFETY`. If set to `THIRD_PARTY`, you must also provide `brand_safety_partner`. For newly available countries or regions targeted with `REACH`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, or `ENGAGEMENT`, `THIRD_PARTY` is not supported. Pre-bid first-party Brand Safety for `APP_PROMOTION`, `WEB_CONVERSIONS`, `TRAFFIC`, and `LEAD_GENERATION` in Auction ads, and pre-bid third-party brand safety, are allowlist-only. `EXPANDED_INVENTORY` will replace `NO_BRAND_SAFETY` and become the default in the next API version.

language.description: Language for the returned location name (`name`). Default is `en`. If the specified language is unsupported, it is ignored and `en` is used. If you specify a supported non-English language, locations outside that language's native country or region might not be translated.

level_range.description: Maximum location level to return. `ALL`: all levels. `TO_COUNTRY`: only country or region. `TO_PROVINCE`: country and province; DMA and Metropolitan are treated as province level. `TO_CITY`: country, province, and city. `TO_DISTRICT`: country, province, city, and district.

objective_type.description: Advertising objective. This field controls other parameters: `shopping_ads_type` is valid only when `objective_type` is `PRODUCT_SALES`; `promotion_target_type` is valid only when `objective_type` is `LEAD_GENERATION`; `rf_campaign_type` must be used only when `objective_type` is `RF_REACH`. Newly available countries or regions are allowlist-only for `TRAFFIC`, `LEAD_GENERATION`, `APP_PROMOTION`, and `WEB_CONVERSIONS` with TikTok placement, and separately allowlist-only for `REACH`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, and `ENGAGEMENT` with TikTok placement. For those newly available countries or regions with `REACH`, `VIDEO_VIEWS`, or `ENGAGEMENT`, `brand_safety_type` cannot be `THIRD_PARTY`.

placements.description: Apps where you want to deliver ads. `brand_safety_type` and `brand_safety_partner` are valid only when `placements` includes `PLACEMENT_TIKTOK`.

promotion_target_type.description: Promotion target type for Lead Generation. Valid only when `objective_type` is `LEAD_GENERATION`. `INSTANT_PAGE` uses an in-app TikTok Instant Form. `EXTERNAL_WEBSITE` uses a landing page with a Website Form or a TikTok Instant Page that redirects to a website form.

rf_campaign_type.description: Used only when `objective_type` is `RF_REACH`. Set to `PULSE` to get available premium contextual tags for a TikTok Pulse campaign; when `PULSE` is used, only one `location_id` is returned. Do not pass this field when `objective_type` is not `RF_REACH`. The returned `location_id` must be passed as `location_ids` to /adgroup/rf/create/ when creating a TikTok Pulse ad group.

shopping_ads_type.description: Shopping ads type. Valid only when `objective_type` is `PRODUCT_SALES`.

video_ids.description: List of video IDs to query. Maximum 60 items per request. If a video cannot be used in ads, that video ID is ignored.

filtering.description: Filters used to narrow the video search.

material_ids.description: List of material IDs. Maximum 20 items.

video_ids.description: List of video IDs to search for. Maximum 100 items. If a video cannot be used in ads, that video ID is ignored. If `video_ids` is omitted and multiple video IDs were generated for the same video due to multiple uploads, only one valid video ID is returned for that video.

video_material_sources.description: List of video material sources to filter by.

video_name.description: Video name for fuzzy matching search.

page.description: Current page number. Default is `1`. Value must be greater than or equal to `1`.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Default is `20`. Valid range: `1` to `100`.
